transaction: scheduled canonical state -> Phase 5 synthesis -> Phase 6 candidate observations -> one Phase 7 global qualification evaluation -> append-only ledger/protected diagnostics
stateMixing: No candidate may score with a different state because the runtime uses each candidate's originating state/synthesis IDs in the deterministic identity.
immutability: Phase 6 candidate records are never updated. Each unique state/model/config evaluation is a separate ledger row.
computeOnce: The scheduled global canonical pipeline calls evaluateAndPersistImportanceQualification once on the global candidate set; user and public surfaces do not recompute it.
